This role will serve as the owner's representative responsible for leading facility planning, programming, design development, and project delivery for manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, office, and secure facility projects.
This position is heavily focused on design management and will be responsible for directing external architecture and engineering (A&E) firms throughout the entire project lifecycle.

The successful candidate will lead stakeholder engagement, requirements development, programming, consultant management, design reviews, constructability reviews, and technical decision-making while ensuring designs align with operational objectives, budget constraints, schedule requirements, security requirements, and long-term facility strategies.
The ideal candidate thrives in environments where requirements are evolving and can effectively guide design teams through ambiguity to produce practical, constructible, and scalable solutions. Construction oversight is expected, but the primary focus of this role is ensuring design quality, design coordination, and successful project definition before construction begins.
The initial assignment will be the planning, design, and delivery of a prototype laboratory facility supporting advanced engineering and development activities.

Serve as the owner's lead representative for facility planning, programming, and design execution.
Manage and direct architecture, engineering, specialty consultant, and design-build teams.
Develop project requirements in partnership with engineering, manufacturing, operations, security, and executive stakeholders.
Convert high-level business and operational objectives into actionable facility and infrastructure requirements.
Lead programming efforts, space planning exercises, feasibility studies, and conceptual design development.
Oversee design development from concept through construction documents.
Establish and manage design schedules, consultant deliverables, review cycles, and design budgets.
Lead design review meetings and drive resolution of technical issues, scope gaps, and coordination conflicts.
Review architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and specialty system designs.
Evaluate designs for constructability, maintainability, operational efficiency, scalability, safety, and lifecycle performance.
Ensure designs support manufacturing operations, engineering workflows, laboratory functions, airfield activities, and secure facility requirements.
Coordinate internal stakeholder reviews and ensure project requirements are properly incorporated into design documents.
Support permitting, entitlement, and regulatory approval efforts.
Provide technical leadership during procurement, contractor selection, and project execution activities.
Manage design-related RFIs, submittals, field modifications, and consultant support during construction.
Utilize AutoCAD to review, coordinate, and comment on design documentation.
Serve as the primary interface between internal stakeholders and external design consultants.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related technical field.
Minimum 10 years of experience in design management, owner's representation, architecture, engineering, facilities development, or capital project delivery.
Demonstrated experience managing architecture and engineering firms on complex facility projects.
Strong understanding of facility planning, programming, design development, and construction documentation.
Experience leading multidisciplinary design teams through all phases of project development.
Ability to review and interpret architectural and engineering drawings, specifications, calculations, and technical documentation.
Working knowledge of building systems, construction methods, codes, and industry best practices.
Proficiency with AutoCAD.
Experience supporting projects in active operational environments, including aviation or airfield facilities.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and decision-making skills.
Ability to work effectively in situations with incomplete or evolving requirements.
Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. SECRET Security Clearance.
Ability to lift 50 pounds or greater and perform site visits in active construction environments.

Active U.S. SECRET Security Clearance or higher.
Experience supporting advanced manufacturing, aerospace, defense, or technology environments.
Experience planning and designing laboratories, prototype development spaces, engineering facilities, or manufacturing operations.
Familiarity with ICD 705 requirements and secure facility design.
Experience with SCIF planning, design, and accreditation processes.
Experience delivering projects using design-build, progressive design-build, or fast-track delivery methods.
Professional registration or certification such as PE, RA, PMP, CCM, LEED, or similar.
Experience managing mission-critical or highly technical facilities.

At AKQA, we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to create a better future. With an entrepreneurial and collaborative approach, we design adaptive ideas, services and experiences that capture the imagination, delivering impressive returns for our clients.
Creatives at AKQA apply artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight to craft beautiful brands, products, campaigns and experiences that stop people in their tracks. Skilled storytellers, they work in a multidisciplinary environment to unlock new value for our clients.
As an Art Director in Beirut, you’ll play an essential role in the strategy, conception and design of beautiful ideas, experiences, products and more. You’ll use your exceptional creative thought and craft skills to produce transformative work for regional and global clients, working with a team of multidisciplinary creatives within the studio and across the network.
At AKQA you will have access to world-renowned thought leadership from influential authors, athletes, artists and entrepreneurs. You will work in an environment which fosters a meritocratic culture and encourages ownership, and you will be surrounded by some of the brightest minds in their fields.

Lead with creative hunger. Drive concepts, visuals, and design systems with the energy of a maker and the ambition of a leader, pushing every idea to be braver, sharper, and more culturally relevant.
Be a storyteller with taste. Shape narratives through visuals, composition, rhythm, and emotion, not just decoration. Every frame, layout, and edit must convey intention, story, and meaning.
Craft with obsession. Whether it's a platform identity, a film, a digital experience, a product UI, or a prototype, treat details like a signature. Your work should feel unmistakably world-class.
Think beyond the screen. Build ideas that live as acts, installations, products, content ecosystems, and tech-enabled experiences, not just campaigns. Bring innovation and experimentation into the room naturally.
Make ideas PR-able by design. Create visuals and concepts that earn cultural attention, not just meet a brief. Understand what travels regionally and globally, and design for impact.
Own the process end-to-end. From early sketches to motion tests to production supervision, push the idea through every phase. Know when to be hands-on and when to lead from altitude.
Collaborate like a modern creative. Work fluidly with writers, strategists, technologists, designers, makers, AI systems, and the broader AKQA network. Seek friction that makes the work stronger.
Elevate the room. Bring energy, references, inspiration, and ideas that push the team forward. Mentor juniors, shape thinking, and help raise the studio's creative temperature.
Challenge the brief, respectfully. Ask the questions others don't. Find the tension, expose the opportunity, and push for the version of the work that truly moves people.
Present with creative conviction. Show work with clarity, story, and craft, helping clients feel the ambition, vision, and emotional intent behind each idea.
Guard the quality. Be accountable for every output. Ensure every visual, layout, prototype, and film frame meets AKQA's global standards and reflects the studio's ambition.

You have a compelling portfolio of work that demonstrates high-quality art direction and concepting across a variety of projects.
Proven creative success working in collaborative, multi-functional teams.
Strong information presentation skills, visual and written.
You have a breadth of cultural reference points.
You have a drive to break boundaries and craft the best ideas of their kind in the world.
You are passionate, driven and obsessed about your craft and stay on top of best practice in your field.
Experience in leading a team and working directly with clients is advantageous.
A degree in Design, Interaction Design, Visual Studies or other design-related field preferred.
Extensive experience using the most common software.
Experience of nurturing client relationships.
Appreciated supplementary skills include a passion for photography, 3D modelling and/or digital installations

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com .

The Creative team at AKQA (part of WPP) applies artistry and craftsmanship to strategic insight, bringing to life beautiful and technologically innovative ideas that move the world. From a variety of backgrounds and disciplines, our creatives are innately curious and strive to transform client challenges into groundbreaking, design-led solutions.
As an Associate Creative Director (Art/Design) in our Amsterdam studio, you’ll inspire and lead a team to craft visually striking concepts and executions across CGI, motion design, and interactive media.

With a foundation in art direction and deep expertise in production, you will direct specialized CGI artists and guide cross-disciplinary teams to create cinematic, technically precise, and emotionally-resonant work.

From large-scale digital platforms and motion-led brand systems, to experimental storytelling powered by emerging tools, you’ll push the boundaries of what’s possible in digital creativity.
You’re a visionary creative leader who thinks like a filmmaker, builds like a technician, and creates like a storyteller, bringing together craft, innovation, and strategy to shape work that influences culture and elevates global brands.
As part of the AKQA team and based in our Amsterdam studio, you’ll work in an environment that fosters a dynamic and inclusive culture, enabled by our multidisciplinary approach and supported by some of the brightest minds in their field. You will report to the Creative Director and collaborate closely with team leads across the studio to continually inspire, innovate, and deliver work of the highest standard.

Deliver and lead award-winning work that meets client needs while influencing culture, blending art direction, design craft, and innovative use of technology.
Direct and Lead autonomous teams to bring cinematic vision, technical precision, and emotional storytelling into every project — thinking like a filmmaker, building like a technician, and creating like a storyteller.
Establish and direct creative foundations in concepting art directions for production and motion graphics, ensuring ideas are strategically sound and visually compelling.
Ability to direct specialised CGI artists across animation, modelling, rigging, lighting, and compositing to maintain creative cohesion and quality.
Apply craft knowledge across CGI workflows, including modelling, lighting, animatics, grading, and retouching.
Provide hands-on expertise in retouching, compositing, grading, and finalising large-scale projects, guiding teams through complex production pipelines.
Implement advanced workflows such as EXR and ACES to ensure colour accuracy, consistency, and creative control.
Contribute to and lead the development of creative briefs, collaborating with clients and strategists to define opportunities and deliver visionary outcomes.
Collaborate across disciplines — including design, UX, and development — to integrate creativity, craft, and strategy seamlessly into final outputs.
Creatively lead new business pitches, presenting ideas and executions with confidence and clarity to global clients.
Explore and implement AI-assisted workflows (e.g., ComfyUI with open-source models, LoRa training, Google partnerships) to push creative boundaries.
Demonstrate proficiency in editing (Adobe Premiere, After Effects), motion retouching (DaVinci), and emerging AI generation tools.

Proven experience at Associate Creative Director level or in a comparable art/design hybrid leadership role, with a strong background in both concepting and execution.
A demonstrated track record of leading award-winning creative work across European and global markets, showcasing the ability to deliver at scale and on an international stage.
You have experience with AI production using state of the art models, knowing the pros and cons of each and what model to use, when to use what, and how to use each through JSON-based prompting - and how to put different outputs together.
Strong foundation in art direction and motion graphics, coupled with advanced CGI production knowledge across the full pipeline, from modeling to post-production.
Hands-on craft expertise in compositing, grading, retouching, and finishing, with the ability to dive into details and elevate the final quality of work.
Sharp eye for art direction, visual storytelling, and design excellence, ensuring all work meets the highest aesthetic and conceptual standards.
Experienced in building and maintaining client relationships, growing partnerships through trust, creativity, and consistent delivery of exceptional results.
Exceptional communicator with the ability to craft and deliver compelling presentations, clearly articulating creative vision, rationale, and executional guidelines.
Recognised for representing your agency publicly—through talks, mentorship, or thought leadership—and inspiring both peers and the next generation of creatives.

At AKQA (part of WPP), we believe in the imaginative application of art and science to design a better future. Our Product Design Directors craft the interfaces, systems, and experiences that define how brands behave in the modern world, across mobile, spatial, voice, wearables, and AI-powered environments.
As a Product Design Director, you’ll lead the design of products and brand experiences for some of the world’s most influential organisations, from luxury ecosystems and cultural platforms to next-generation mobility and wellness systems. You’ll guide multi-disciplinary teams to create elegant, human-centred design solutions that are as intelligent as they are inspiring.
You’ll define design direction across a portfolio of complex, high-impact digital products, establishing benchmarks in accessibility, interaction, and multi-modal experience. You’ll champion the new frontier of brand user interfaces: adaptive design languages that translate brand identity into behaviour, sound, motion, and intelligence.
AKQA Product Design Directors operate at the intersection of brand, craft, and computation, working side-by-side with strategy, data, and engineering teams to shape products that learn, evolve, and earn love over time.
This is a leadership role within AKQA’s London studio, part of a globally connected studio network shaping the future of digital experiences for brands including Nike, Rolls-Royce, Samsung, Airbnb, and Google. You’ll be at the forefront of AI-powered product design, helping redefine how creativity, intelligence, and empathy coexist in every interaction.

Lead concept, design, and delivery of world-class digital products and connected experiences that define new standards for creativity and usability.
Partner with UX, Creative Technology, and AI Engineering teams to shape AI-native interfaces, generative UI systems, and adaptive design components.
Establish and evolve brand-led design systems that perform across screen, voice, gesture, and spatial interfaces.
Embed accessibility and inclusivity from first principles, ensuring WCAG compliance and usability for all audiences.
Drive experimentation across new modalities: voice and audio UX, wearable ecosystems, computer vision, and mixed reality.
Mentor, grow, and inspire a diverse team of product designers, cultivating craftsmanship, critical thinking, and innovation.
Collaborate closely with strategists and client partners to translate brand purpose into tangible, useful digital products.
Represent AKQA in new business opportunities, articulating the value of design in solving complex business and human challenges.
Contribute to AKQA’s global culture of learning, sharing insights on design ethics, AI co-creation, and emerging interaction paradigms.

10+ years’ experience (as a guide, not a restriction) in product design or interaction design at leading studios or in-house teams.
Proven leadership in delivering large-scale, multi-platform digital products from concept to launch.
Mastery of Figma and contemporary design-system workflows (tokens, auto-layout, component libraries), along with complementary tools such as code-based interaction design software and no-code web/app solutions.
Strong understanding of human-centred design, accessibility, motion, and micro-interaction principles.
Familiarity with AI design tools, prototyping in Framer, Principle, ProtoPie, or After Effects, and collaboration with machine-learning or data-science teams.
Demonstrable success in uniting brand and product through interface design, e.g. motion language, sound design, or spatial storytelling.
Experience mentoring mid- and senior-level designers; a track record of growing creative excellence and cultural impact.
Comfortable presenting to senior clients and executives, and confident operating within fast-paced, high-stakes environments.
Systems thinker with a deep sensitivity to brand and narrative.
Calm, credible communicator who brings clarity and optimism to complex challenges.
Obsessed with emerging technologies and their human potential.
Advocate for inclusive design and accessible innovation.
Balances bold vision with precision in craft.
Please include your portfolio link and examples of your work in your application. We are not able to accept applications that do not include a link to your work.

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

This role is part of our Marketing team based in Berlin. You’ll work with a vibrant mix of talents, ranging from Brand Strategists, Creatives, Designers, Social Experts and Influencer Marketers to Account managers and Producers. As a digital creative marketing agency, we mix traditional storytelling with the best of what today’s technology has to offer to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients.
We’re looking for a talented and strategic Art Director to join fast-paced, high-performing, and most visible dynamic accounts. This is a hands-on role for someone who brings conceptual thinking, sharp visual design capabilities, and video-first experience to the table. Someone who can translate strategy into smart, engaging creative that hooks niche audiences.
You’ll partner closely with a team of Copywriters, Video Editors, Content Creators, Visual Designers and report into the Creative Director, collaborating to bring creative briefs to life across digital, social, and video channels. You’ll help shape always-on social and campaign direction, lead visual execution, and ensure design excellence from kickoff through delivery. You’ll play a crucial role in owning your workstream and consistently raising the creative bar.
This role is perfect for someone who thrives in creative collaboration, is autonomous in ideation, enjoys rolling up their sleeves to execute, and has a strong point of view on what makes effective content in the digital world.

Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.
Contribute to pre-production planning, support on-set shoots, and collaborate with editors and designers in post to ensure work comes to life as intended.
Work closely with copywriters, strategists, producers, project managers, and client teams to ensure creative aligns with brief goals, brand voice, and business objectives.
Navigate ambiguity with CD support, adapt to shifting priorities, and bring proactive solutions to creative and production challenges. These solutions should come in the form of daily brainstorming and inspiration sharing with the team.
Approach every situation with curiosity, kindness, and accountability to help foster an inclusive and collaborative team environment.

4+ years of experience in visual design with a strong portfolio showcasing digital campaigns, social-first content, and video-driven work.
Native German with excellent English skills, capable of working with German and international brands.
Prior agency experience or relevant experience with a track record of navigating high-volume, high-visibility accounts.
On-set and content production experience (domestic or international), including working with video directors, editors, and producers.
Strong client presentation and communication skills - you can confidently present ideas, take feedback in stride, and advocate for great creative.
Excellent design sensibility and a strategic eye for layout, typography, motion, and branding. Additionally, deep knowledge of social best practices for optimal performance.
A proactive, collaborative mindset - you bring energy to brainstorms, jump in where needed, and support your teammates with generosity and respect.
A creative portfolio that shows your eye for design, your range in digital, video, and your ability to turn strategy into scroll-stopping creative.
You don’t just talk about AI—you use it. You have a proven track record of incorporating AI tools into your workflow to solve creative problems.

Deliver High-Impact Creative: Concept and design best-in-class digital creative across social, and video, with a strong focus on visual storytelling and performance.

About Stripe
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

The Product Design team is composed of several teams that work together to help define, create, and deliver all user-facing aspects of the Stripe brand and product. Product Design Managers work directly with Engineering leaders, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and Marketers in each product area. Together, they identify the strategy and vision, and drive execution for critical initiatives that create a world-class support experience for all Stripe customers and users.
Global Payments builds on core Stripe financial products and creates solutions that empower businesses to expand into new markets worldwide without the friction of complex global operations. The sheer volume of payments that flow through Stripe on an hourly basis necessitates the highest level of craft and reliability, which means that Global Payments product designers have the chance to create and ship the best work of their careers.

As the leader of the Global Payments Design team, you will shape the products and experiences that make it as easy for businesses to sell globally as it is to sell locally.

This team oversees product experiences around cross-border commerce, covering local payment methods, global tax compliance, localized consumer experiences, and moving money across borders.

You'll ensure that any business can use Stripe to reach customers anywhere in the world, including fast-growing companies that expect to operate globally from day one.
You'll lead and grow a team of experienced designers who have a track record of navigating ambiguity and delivering high-impact solutions that improve payments experiences for Stripe users.

Work across Stripe teams and establish collaboration practices that result in holistic solutions for a horizontal product space
Work closely with Product Management, Product Engineering, Marketing, and senior leadership to drive fast decision making, create clarity, and raise the bar for craft and impact
Inspire, motivate, and lead designers across experience levels to do the best work of their careers

We are looking for a senior Art Director to lead and evolve our approach to image-led storytelling at Bakken & Bæck.

Bakken & Bæck is a design and technology studio that helps companies break new ground. Building digital products, brands and businesses, we help ambitious companies identify, explore and respond to new opportunities. As one team working out of Oslo, Amsterdam, Bonn, Barcelona, and London, we have all the skill-sets needed to help businesses adapt to an increasingly complex world.

We believe the best teams are driven by people with small egos and huge hearts. We strongly believe in flexibility, care deeply about craft, and are at our best working closely together. We want BB to be a place where you can try out new things with the risk of failing, where you can take ownership over your own work, and where there’s a low barrier for coming up with ideas — no matter your job title or discipline.

We’re looking for an experienced Art Director to lead and elevate how we approach image-led storytelling and brand experiences at Bakken & Bæck. Much of our work is about making complex technologies understandable and relevant through strong concepts, distinctive visual languages, and emotionally resonant creative systems.

This is a role for someone who thinks through images first and understands how photography, film, illustration, CGI, motion, and digital systems come together to build coherent and culturally sharp brand worlds. Much of our work sits at the intersection of technology, product, and communication – translating complexity into visual experiences that feel immediate, human, and emotionally resonant.

You will shape the visual direction of projects from early concepts and treatments through to production and final execution, working closely with designers, developers, strategists and writers.

As Art Director, you will commission and direct external collaborators, from photographers and filmmakers to illustrators and 3D artists, ensuring every output feels intentional, distinctive, and aligned with the broader brand vision.

We’re looking for someone with a sharp eye for contemporary visual culture and a strong understanding of how image systems scale across web, social, motion, and emerging technology contexts. You know how to translate strategic thinking into visual experiences that feel precise, ambitious, and built to last.

We’re currently envisioning this as a freelance role spanning several months and across multiple projects. Capacity can range from 50-100%, with flexibility to shape the scope around the right person. Depending on experience and fit, the role could start broader or expand over time as needs evolve.

The role can start fully remote, but as there is a possibility of transitioning into a permanent position, we’re looking for candidates who are based in, or open to relocating to, one of our office locations.

Leading art direction across brand and BB projects through conception, execution, and delivery.

Defining the visual world of a brand through image-led storytelling (photography, film, illustration, CGI and motion).

Developing clear image-making principles, including mood, casting, styling, lighting, composition, and post-production direction.

About the Role Forbes Advisor is hiring a Creative Directorof Paid Social to own end-to-end creative across our Health vertical, a portfolio that today includes weight loss medications, hair loss, hearing, TRT, and dating.

You will concept, write, direct, and supervise editorial on the paid social and native creative that drives acquisition for Forbes and its partners, and you will lead a pod of creatives doing the same. This is a direct-response storyteller's role layered with creative management responsibility.

The role reports into the VP Creative and partners with our Paid Social and Native Buyers, who direct the spend, and vertical General Managers, who own category outcomes. The successful candidate is a senior creative leader.

You are fluent in the modern direct-response canon, comfortable in regulated health categories, and produce video and copy atperformance-marketing pace without sacrificing craft.

You have built and led creative teams before, and you can run a small team of senior individual contributors (creative leadsandeditors)and personallytakingon high priority projects yourself.You move fluently across content modes (remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, AI-generated content) and pick the right mode forpipeline needs.Above all, youare equally at home concepting on a page, directing on set, supervising an edit, and reviewing your team's work with sharp, useful notes.

We are a human-led shop that uses AI to accelerate output without diluting craft, and you will be expected tooperatethat way from day one. You can articulate where AI sharpens video storytelling and where it weakens it. In short,AI fluency is a baseline expectation. You already use it to improve the quality and efficiency of your work.

RESPONSIBILITIES: Own end-to-end creative for theHealthvertical: concept, copy, direction, post, and the operating system(s)that produces it. Lead the Health creative pod (Creative Leads, editors, producers). Hire, develop, and raise the bar across the team. Partner with the VP Creative on org design as the team grows.

Concept new storytelling angles and write or supervise scripts from blank page to final cut across paid social and native video. Stay hands-on for heroor category-defining work. Produce across the full range of contentmodesthe vertical demands: remote UGC, in-studio and on-location shoots, and AI-generated content.

Match production mode topipeline needs. Direct documentary-style, on-camera interviews with doctors, telehealth providers, patients, and UGC creators. Coach others on the team to direct interviews to the same bar. Collaborate with editors from pre-production through delivery. Own the cut on hero work, supervise the rest.

Analyze performance data and use it to drive incremental and step-change creative optimizations that scale. Work fluently inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated category guardrails, partner overlays). Keep persuasion and compliance aligned rather than in tension.

Provide regular updates on creative performance, hiring, and craft initiatives to the Creative leadership team and to Health vertical stakeholders. Available to travel to locations to film, gather footage, and conduct interviews.

REQUIREMENTS : 10+ years of direct-response creative experience in performance-driven environments (supplements, health, telehealthor comparable), with at least 3 years in a creative management role. Demonstrated experience leading and growing a creative team of 5+ individual contributors across writing, directing, and post.

Portfolio of video adswith clear performance attribution. We want to see the actual work and hear the actual results, includingworkyour teamproducedunder your direction. Mastery of direct-response narrative architecture: hook, problem, mechanism, proof, transition, offer, and CTA. Working command of the modern direct-response canon.

AI-augmented creative fluency. Regular use of AI toolsacross ideation, scripting, and post. Production fluency across multiple content modes: remote UGC at volume, in-person studio and location shoots, and AI-generated or AI-assisted content. You can pick the right mode for the brief. Strong on-set craft.

You can run a shoot yourself, direct non-actor talent, and hold the bar from concept through final cut. Editorial voice fluency. You can direct an interview that feels like a real conversation andshapea story that feels like a story, not a sales letter shot on camera. Demonstrated speed and volume in performance marketing environments.

Comfortable shipping multiple cuts and tests a week across multiple categories and iterating from data. Comfort working inside compliance rails (FDA-style health claims, regulated health category language, partner brand guardrails). Strong collaboration skills across Creative, Buying,verticalGMs, Editorial, Brand, and Legal.

Self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, comfortable in a start-up style operating environment. Excellent communication and organizational skills. STRONG PLUSES: Direct experience with GLP-1, weight loss, hair loss, telehealth, or comparable regulated health DR categories. Quiz funnel and branching-narrative video experience.

Familiarity with the publisher and native-ad ecosystem (Outbrain, Taboola, sponsored content). Comfort reading performance dashboards (Looker, Tableau, in-platform reporting).

Experience building reusable AI workflows for creative production: templates, Claude Projects or custom GPTs, prompt libraries, or agentic tooling that compounds team output without diluting craft. Screenwriting or long-form visual storytelling background.

Tendril exists to amplify the genius of ambitious brands. We help category leaders, innovators, and creators bring their ideas to life through multi-dimensional brand expression — extending brands across motion, sound, toolkits and design systems. Our work enables people to truly see, understand, and appreciate the craft, thinking, and intent behind complex products, platforms, and worlds that might otherwise be missed.

An Art Director defines and oversees the visual vision of a project, shaping its aesthetic, mood, and storytelling language. You collaborate closely with Directors, Producers, and the Artists that you manage to ensure that design, animation, and technical execution come together in a cohesive, high-quality whole.

With a refined eye for craft and a strong grasp of visual systems, you balance creative intuition with practical execution, translating abstract ideas into clear visual frameworks that amplify each project’s narrative and emotional impact, and help elevate your direct report’s skillset.

The Opportunity
Manage a team of Artists through regular touchpoints, feedback, and guidance to help you deliver on concepts for projects.
Partner with the Director to define and uphold a project’s visual vision; guiding style, tone, and storytelling from concept through delivery.
Translate ideas and briefs into unified design systems and look explorations that inform every creative and technical decision throughout production.
Work hands-on in design, contributing both conceptual thinking and “on-the-box” execution to support layout, cinematography, composition, and animation.
Collaborate with production, design, and technical leads to ensure creative intent aligns with scope, schedule, and resources while protecting overall quality.
Provide constructive, empowering feedback to Artists and Animators, helping them refine visual language, craft consistency, and storytelling clarity.
Draw inspiration from evolving trends in motion design, film, fashion, fine art, and emerging technologies, using them to keep the studio’s visual language bold and relevant.
Elevate each project’s creative outcome by ensuring every frame contributes meaningfully to the story and embodies Tendril’s standard of visual excellence.
Come Prepared to Talk About
How you like to provide guidance, feedback, and mentorship to Artists to assist in their growth and development
Your approach to staying engaged in the craft itself for when you need to be “on-the-box”
How you keep your visual language fresh by exploring trends in design, technology, and culture and how you’ve contributed this research to the places you’ve worked and people you’ve managed
How you collaborate with Directors to establish a project’s visual direction

$100,000-$120,000

Deine Rolle
Die Beratungsbranche in Deutschland sieht überall gleich aus. Gleiche Bildwelten, gleiche Stockfotos, gleiche Blautöne, gleiche Sprache. Marke ist in diesem Markt praktisch unbesetzt.
Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis.

Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen.

Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht.
Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System.

Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt.

Bei Vogel findest du beides: Strukturen, die tragen, und ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Aufbau-Versprechen ohne Boden.
Du verantwortest das gesamte visuelle System von Vogel und der weiteren Marken, die daneben entstehen — Print, Digital, Raum, Bewegtbild, Experience. Du setzt selbst um und ziehst Partner dort zu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung es erfordert. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Die Rolle sitzt in München, vor Ort. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in die fachliche Führung des Design- und Brand-Bereichs.
Deine Verantwortung
Visuelles System und Markenführung
Du verantwortest das Designsystem von Vogel — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache, Layout-Prinzipien, Komponenten — und entwickelst es weiter, statt es nur zu verwalten.
Du überträgst das System in Content: Social, Publikationen, Whitepaper, Präsentationen, Recruiting-Material. Das System ist erst fertig, wenn andere im Unternehmen damit arbeiten können, ohne dich zu fragen.
Du setzt die visuellen Systeme der weiteren Marken auf, die bei Vogel entstehen.
Dein Maßstab: Wer drei unserer Touchpoints nebeneinander sieht, erkennt sie ohne Logo als Vogel.
Gestaltung über alle Medien
Print: Publikationen, Geschäftsausstattung, Mandantenkommunikation, Kampagnenmotive — von der ersten Skizze bis zur Druckfreigabe in deiner Hand.
Webdesign: Du gestaltest vogel-beratung.com und die dazugehörigen Seiten weiter, im direkten Austausch mit unserem Webentwickler. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du das Webdesign für alle Standorte und Gesellschaften der Vogel-Gruppe.
Eventdesign und räumliche Gestaltung: Standorte, Bühnen, eigene Veranstaltungsformate, Messeauftritte. Du gestaltest, wie Vogel sich anfühlt, wenn man im Raum steht.
Experience Design: Du denkst den Weg von Mandanten und Bewerbern als gestaltete Abfolge, nicht als Sammlung einzelner Assets.
Kreativ-Steuerung, Partner und Nachwuchs
Du steuerst Agenturen, Kreativpartner, Fotografen und Freelancer — Briefing, Auswahl, Qualitätsurteil, Freigabe. Zugeliefert wird Kapazität, die Handschrift bleibt deine.
Du steuerst Motion Design von der Konzeption bis zur Abnahme und stellst sicher, dass Bewegtbild aus demselben System kommt wie alles andere.
Du leitest unsere Design-Praktikanten und Berufseinsteiger fachlich an, gibst Feedback am Handwerk und baust darauf perspektivisch dein eigenes Team auf.
Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet hier den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater.
Deine Perspektiven

s.h: Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast
s.t:
Du hast das visuelle System ausgebaut — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache und Komponenten sind erkennbar weiterentwickelt, nicht nur inventarisiert.
Du hast vogel-beratung.com überarbeitet, die neuen Seiten sind live.
Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für alle Designthemen im Unternehmen — Anfragen laufen bei dir zusammen, statt bei Externen zu landen.
Du lieferst konstanten Output an Assets über alle Kanäle, ohne dass Themen liegen bleiben.
Die Marke beginnt, deine Handschrift zu tragen.

s.h: Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast
s.t:
Das Designsystem ist in Figma so aufgesetzt, dass Content-, Growth- und Recruiting-Themen ohne dich sauber daraus produzieren.
Die täglichen Assets aus dem Beratungsalltag — Präsentationen, Slides, Mandantenunterlagen — entstehen automatisiert per KI auf Basis deines Designsystems. Dass das trägt, hängt an sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren technischen Setup: beides liegt bei dir.
Das Designsystem und die Assets aller Sub-Marken der Vogel-Gruppe sind ausgebaut und angewendet — jede Marke hat ein eigenes visuelles Fundament, das erkennbar aus derselben Logik kommt.
Dein Partner-Setup steht: ausgewählte Agenturen und Kreativpartner, klare Briefing-Standards, Qualitätsurteil bei dir.
Motion Design läuft als eigener Produktionsstrang unter deiner Steuerung.

s.h: Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast
s.t:
Vogel ist visuell unverwechselbar — im Markt zuordenbar, ohne dass ein Logo nötig ist.
Eine neue Marke setzt du visuell in Wochen auf, nicht in Quartalen — das System trägt das, ohne dass du jedes Asset selbst baust.
Du hast mindestens einen Junior-Designer eingestellt, eingearbeitet und auf ein Niveau gebracht, auf dem er eigene Strecken trägt.

Der nächste Schritt ist die fachliche Führung von Design und Brand über alle Marken hinweg (IC-Karriere) — das setzt ein visuelles System voraus, das ohne dich trägt, nicht nur zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Wenn du das Team mit aufbaust und führen willst, öffnet sich zusätzlich die Führungslaufbahn. Wir kennen keinen Automatismus „mehr Erfahrung gleich höhere Stufe".
Das bringst du mit
Erfahrung & Track Record
Du hast ein Portfolio auf höchstem Niveau — Grafikdesign, Typografie, Branding-Systeme, visuelles Storytelling. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht der Lebenslauf.
Du hast in einem professionellen Setup produziert: Agentur mit Design- oder Branding-Fokus, eigenes Studio, oder Inhouse bei einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Berufsjahre sind für uns ein Indiz, kein Kriterium — wir entscheiden an Arbeiten und an Umsetzungsfähigkeit.
Du hast Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, visuelle Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares studiert — oder du hast dir das Handwerk selbst beigebracht und kannst das mit Arbeiten belegen, die den Abschluss ersetzen.
Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber visuelles Urteil und Umsetzungstiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett.

Konkret: Designer aus einem kleinen Studio ohne große Namen, dessen Arbeiten besser sind als das, was große Agenturen abliefern; Art Director aus einem Feld weit weg von B2B — Mode, Kultur, Gastronomie, Musik — mit systemischem Denken; Architekt oder Szenograf mit ausgeprägtem Gespür für Typografie und Fläche; Autodidakt mit eigenem Magazin, Label oder Projekt, das visuell trägt.

Die ausgewiesene Range ist auf das Primärprofil ausgelegt. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen .
